concepts.prompt: Game prop concept: a village shop counter, long wooden counter 2.4 m wide, 1.05 m tall, 0.7 m deep, warm oak with raised front panelling and a thick worn countertop. On top: glass jars of preserves and sweets, a basket of round bread loaves, folded colourful cloth bolts (cream, sage green and blue), a small brass scale. Cosy friendly village general store, matches the village in the key art. Stylised Palworld-like game prop, chunky readable shapes, soft bevelled edges, hand-painted PBR look, warm natural palette matching the Meadows key art (first reference). Single isolated object, centred, neutral grey background, even studio lighting, no text, no characters, no ground clutter.

agent_visual_verdict: Good: panelled oak counter with jars, bread basket, cloth bolts and a brass scale; goods are small but readable.
